summary: The fractal-ui kit adds an interactive QuestionForm for harness asks: radio and checkbox options, an automatic Other row, per-question notes, Recommended badges, markdown option previews, a tab strip with answered markers that stacks below 600 px, and keyboard answering (arrows, 1-9, Tab, Enter). A form waiting on the viewer carries the attention hairline and glyph, the header shows who asked and how long ago, and read-only requests are labelled as such. It ships with an Explore story. Separately, a kit Markdown block that opens with a heading now sits flush with its container: the first heading has no top margin.

compatibility.detail: Additive kit export, plus one visual change on every kit Markdown surface: a leading heading loses its top margin. The props mirror the question model on the pending question-forms app branch, plus a required host clock (now); the application has no question renderer yet and nothing on main uses the form.
